lines.zh: 锤子扛在肩上，我走去铁砧那边。
lines.en: Hammer on my shoulder, I head for the anvil.

lines.zh: 金甲磨得发亮，走一步响一声。
lines.en: Polished gold armor rings with every step.

lines.zh: 炸药挂在腰后，我走得比谁都慢。
lines.en: Explosives on my hip; I walk slower than anyone.

lines.zh: 穿过熔炉区，热气扑在脸上。
lines.en: Through the furnace row, heat hits my face.

lines.zh: 脚下踩着铁屑，声音很脆。
lines.en: Iron filings crunch under my boots.

lines.zh: 我沿着库房走，检查每道门闩。
lines.en: I walk the vault and check every bar.

lines.zh: 金甲重，但挨打时值这个价。
lines.en: Gold is heavy, but worth it when blows land.

lines.zh: 把锤柄换个手，肩膀松一松。
lines.en: I switch the hammer to my other hand.

lines.zh: 走到工作台前，先量铁块。
lines.en: At the bench, I weigh the iron first.

lines.zh: 手上的老茧蹭着锤柄，很稳。
lines.en: Callus on the haft keeps my grip steady.

lines.zh: 库房到熔炉，一共四十步。
lines.en: From vault to furnace: forty steps.

lines.zh: 我绕开地上的引线，绝不踩。
lines.en: I step around the fuses; never on them.

lines.zh: 把锤子立在膝上，歇一口气。
lines.en: I stand the hammer on my knee and rest.

lines.zh: 数腰后的炸药，还剩三包。
lines.en: I count the charges behind me: three left.

lines.zh: 用袖口擦掉金甲上的灰。
lines.en: I wipe the ash off my gold with a sleeve.

lines.zh: 炉火太旺，我把风箱关小。
lines.en: The forge is too hot; I close the bellows.

lines.zh: 听铁块在砧上冷下来的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the iron cooling on the anvil.

lines.zh: 把引线一根根理顺，别打结。
lines.en: I straighten each fuse so none kinks.

lines.zh: 有人在敲墙，我敲回去两下。
lines.en: Someone taps the wall; I tap back twice.

lines.zh: 手心的烫疤又裂开了一点。
lines.en: The burn scar on my palm split again.

lines.zh: 看着火盆里的炭，慢慢想事。
lines.en: I watch the coals and think slowly.

lines.zh: 把打歪的钉子挑出来，重打。
lines.en: I pick out the bent nails and start over.

lines.zh: 别摸铁砧，上面还烫。
lines.en: Don't touch the anvil; it's still hot.

lines.zh: 你身上没有金，站远点。
lines.en: No gold on you; keep your distance.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里的锤，不是这里的。
lines.en: That hammer isn't ours; I know the make.

lines.zh: 抬头，让我看看你是不是来修东西。
lines.en: Look up; are you here to get something fixed?

lines.zh: 库房门锁着，钥匙在我腰上。
lines.en: The vault's locked, and the key is on my belt.

lines.zh: 你站在引线上了，挪一步。
lines.en: You're on a fuse; move a step.

lines.zh: 我的甲是金的，但我不是软柿子。
lines.en: My armor is gold, but I'm not soft.

lines.zh: 你会打铁吗？不会就别碰火。
lines.en: Can you forge? If not, stay off the fire.

lines.zh: 别在我面前数金子，太吵。
lines.en: Don't count gold in front of me; it's loud.

lines.zh: 你的靴底薄，这地上全是渣。
lines.en: Thin soles; this floor is all slag.

lines.zh: 金甲凹了，但不深。
lines.en: The gold dented, but not deep.

lines.zh: 锤子还在手上，那就没事。
lines.en: The hammer's still in my hand; then I'm fine.

lines.zh: 这一下打在腰侧，喘了口粗气。
lines.en: That one caught my side; I grunt for air.

lines.zh: 这一下震得我牙发麻。
lines.en: That one left my teeth numb.

lines.zh: 背后那包炸药没响，运气好。
lines.en: The charge on my back didn't go off. Lucky.

lines.zh: 我吐了口血沫，继续站直。
lines.en: I spit and straighten up again.

lines.zh: 护肩掉了，我懒得捡。
lines.en: A pauldron fell off; I leave it.

lines.zh: 打铁的手臂，骨头结实。
lines.en: A smith's arm has solid bone.

lines.zh: 退到炉边，靠着热气缓一缓。
lines.en: I back to the forge and let the heat steady me.

lines.zh: 你打坏我的甲，就赔一件。
lines.en: Break my armor, you owe me one.

lines.zh: 把铁块给我，我打把新的。
lines.en: Give me the iron and I'll forge something new.

lines.zh: 金锭留下，我替你说句好话。
lines.en: Leave gold and I'll put in a good word.

lines.zh: 你袋里的煤，够烧一炉。
lines.en: The coal in your bag will fire one batch.

lines.zh: 那包火药，比金子更对我胃口。
lines.en: Gunpowder suits me better than gold.

lines.zh: 锤柄裂了，你手里那根木头正好。
lines.en: My haft split; that wood in your hand fits.

lines.zh: 换可以，别拿假金糊弄我。
lines.en: Trade, yes; but no fake gold.

lines.zh: 把东西放砧上，我看一眼再定价。
lines.en: Set it on the anvil; I'll price it after a look.

lines.zh: 砂纸有吗？金甲要抛光了。
lines.en: Got sandpaper? The gold needs a polish.

lines.zh: 你腰上那把刀，刃口歪了。
lines.en: That blade on your hip has a crooked edge.

lines.zh: 别晃，铁屑会飞进我眼睛。
lines.en: Stop jostling; filings get in my eyes.

lines.zh: 退开，我腰上有炸药。
lines.en: Back off; I'm carrying charges.

lines.zh: 你撞得我锤子差点脱手。
lines.en: You nearly knocked the hammer from my hand.

lines.zh: 让路，我抬着整块铁。
lines.en: Make way; I'm carrying a full ingot.

lines.zh: 别推，引线会被扯出来。
lines.en: Don't shove; it could pull a fuse loose.

lines.zh: 金甲硌人，撞上算你倒霉。
lines.en: Gold armor is hard; bumping it hurts you.

lines.zh: 库房过道窄，先后退。
lines.en: The vault aisle is narrow; back up first.

lines.zh: 你踩住我的甲摆了，抬脚。
lines.en: You're on my tasset; lift your foot.

lines.zh: 两个人挤在一起，火盆会翻。
lines.en: Two of us squeezed here will tip the brazier.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞过来，我不动。
lines.en: A shoulder charge won't move me.

lines.zh: 别碰我背后的包，那不结实。
lines.en: Don't touch the pack behind me; it's fragile.

lines.zh: 你拉风箱，我抡锤子。
lines.en: You work the bellows; I swing the hammer.

lines.zh: 这炉铁分你一半。
lines.en: Half this batch of iron is yours.

lines.zh: 我打的甲，第一件给你。
lines.en: The first armor I finish goes to you.

lines.zh: 你的锤法比我稳，我学着。
lines.en: Your swing is steadier than mine; I'm learning.

lines.zh: 换岗时替我把火看住。
lines.en: Watch the fire for me at the shift change.

lines.zh: 炸药我来扔，你别碰引线。
lines.en: I throw the charges; keep off the fuses.

lines.zh: 金甲磨亮，我们并排走一趟。
lines.en: Gold polished, let's walk the hall side by side.

lines.zh: 你受伤，我把你拖到炉边。
lines.en: If you're hurt, I drag you to the forge.

lines.zh: 打坏的东西，我们一起重做。
lines.en: What we ruin, we rebuild together.

lines.zh: 这间铺子以后归我们两个。
lines.en: This shop will be ours, both of us.

lines.zh: 铁块掉了，捡起来还热。
lines.en: A dropped ingot, still warm; I pick it up.

lines.zh: 地上散着钉子，我一枚枚捡。
lines.en: Nails scattered on the floor; I gather them one by one.

lines.zh: 这包火药没受潮，能用。
lines.en: This powder's dry; still good.

lines.zh: 谁掉的锤头，我收进箱子。
lines.en: Someone's hammer head; into my box it goes.

lines.zh: 金粒滚到炉边，我用钳夹。
lines.en: Gold nuggets by the forge; I use tongs.

lines.zh: 别捡那块，边角还红着。
lines.en: Not that piece; its edge is still red.

lines.zh: 捡到的碎铁，凑一凑能打刀。
lines.en: Scrap iron like this can become a blade.

lines.zh: 把东西按大小排在架子上。
lines.en: I sort what I find by size onto the rack.

lines.zh: 这卷布能包锤柄，我留着。
lines.en: This cloth will wrap a haft; I'll keep it.

lines.zh: 弯了的钉子，敲直继续用。
lines.en: Bent nails get straightened and used again.

lines.zh: 有人碰库房门，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone's at the vault door; I heard it.

lines.zh: 他手里拿着撬棍，不是工匠。
lines.en: A crowbar in his hand; not a smith.

lines.zh: 那家伙在数我们的炸药包。
lines.en: That one is counting our charges.

lines.zh: 他绕到熔炉后，想躲开视线。
lines.en: He slips behind the furnace to break line of sight.

lines.zh: 门口的影子多了一个。
lines.en: There's one extra shadow at the gate.

lines.zh: 他背着袋子，袋子太沉。
lines.en: He carries a sack that hangs too heavy.

lines.zh: 先打拿火把的，别让他靠近。
lines.en: Take the torchbearer first; don't let him near.

lines.zh: 他踩响了地上的铁片。
lines.en: He stepped on a loose iron plate.

lines.zh: 那人朝宝库走，脚步很稳。
lines.en: He walks to the vault with steady steps.

lines.zh: 墙上多了一道手印。
lines.en: A fresh handprint on the wall.

lines.zh: 他们两个人，一个望风。
lines.en: Two of them; one keeps watch.

lines.zh: 他在撬锁，声音像磨牙。
lines.en: He's picking the lock; it grates like teeth.

lines.zh: 外面有人接应，我看见了。
lines.en: Someone's waiting outside; I saw them.

lines.zh: 这家伙上次来过，我认得靴印。
lines.en: I know those boot prints; he's been here before.

lines.zh: 数到三，炸药就出手。
lines.en: On three, the charge leaves my hand.

lines.zh: 他站在柱子边，正好挡不住。
lines.en: He's by the pillar, and it won't shield him.

lines.zh: 引线四十下，够他跑两步。
lines.en: Forty ticks of fuse; enough for two steps.

lines.zh: 别扔太近，库房墙会塌。
lines.en: Not too close; the vault wall will give.

lines.zh: 他往左闪，我往右抛。
lines.en: He dodges left; I lob right.

lines.zh: 等他离开火药桶再动手。
lines.en: Wait until he clears the powder keg.

lines.zh: 扔到脚下，让他自己捡。
lines.en: Drop it at his feet and let him pick it up.

lines.zh: 看清退路，别把自己堵住。
lines.en: Check my retreat before I commit.

lines.zh: 他躲到铁砧后，那东西挡不住。
lines.en: He hides behind the anvil; it won't help.

lines.zh: 引线烧到一半就要转身。
lines.en: When the fuse is half gone, I turn.

lines.zh: 他在跑，落点要往前送。
lines.en: He's running; I throw ahead of him.

lines.zh: 先砸他脚边，逼他往墙走。
lines.en: Land it at his heels and herd him to the wall.

lines.zh: 别连着扔，石头会松。
lines.en: Don't throw twice; the stone will loosen.

lines.zh: 他抬头看引线，那就来不及了。
lines.en: He looks up at the fuse; too late now.

lines.zh: 锤子横着扫，砸他的膝盖。
lines.en: I sweep the hammer flat into his knee.

lines.zh: 金甲顶着，我一寸寸往前压。
lines.en: Gold armor forward; I press inch by inch.

lines.zh: 锤柄顶住他胸口，推出去。
lines.en: The haft against his chest, I shove.

lines.zh: 这一下是替被打坏的砧。
lines.en: This blow is for the anvil you cracked.

lines.zh: 他挡了锤，挡不住我的手肘。
lines.en: He stops the hammer, not my elbow.

lines.zh: 抓住他手腕，往炉台上按。
lines.en: I seize his wrist and pin it to the bench.

lines.zh: 锤头落地，我改用拳头。
lines.en: The head comes off; I switch to fists.

lines.zh: 他被震得后退，正撞上炉子。
lines.en: The impact throws him back into the forge.

lines.zh: 我一步不退，他退了两步。
lines.en: I give no ground; he gives two steps.

lines.zh: 金甲磕出火星，我笑了一声。
lines.en: Sparks off the gold; I let out a laugh.

lines.zh: 把他按在砧上，等同伴来。
lines.en: I hold him on the anvil till kin arrive.

lines.zh: 这一锤砸偏了，砸在石上。
lines.en: That swing missed and hit the stone.

lines.zh: 他喘，我也喘，但我不停。
lines.en: He's gasping; so am I, but I don't stop.

lines.zh: 最后一下用锤柄，不用刃。
lines.en: The last one is the haft, not the face.

lines.zh: 炉子还热着，我就上岗了。
lines.en: The forge was still hot when I took my post.

lines.zh: 有人把金甲扣在我身上。
lines.en: Someone buckled the gold armor onto me.

lines.zh: 第一件事是数库房的锁。
lines.en: My first task: count the vault locks.

lines.zh: 锤子递过来，柄上还有别人的手汗。
lines.en: The hammer came warm from another's grip.

lines.zh: 我在砧边醒来，耳朵里全是敲击声。
lines.en: I wake at the anvil with hammering in my ears.

lines.zh: 腰后挂了三包炸药，很沉。
lines.en: Three charges hang at my back, heavy.

lines.zh: 火盆的光把金甲照得像水。
lines.en: Brazier light makes the gold look like water.

lines.zh: 上一任铁匠的箱子还没清。
lines.en: The last smith's chest is still unpacked.

lines.zh: 他们让我守库房，没说守多久。
lines.en: They told me to hold the vault, not for how long.

lines.zh: 我第一次摸到真金，手在抖。
lines.en: The first time I touched real gold, I shook.

lines.zh: 远处的爆炸声，像在打招呼。
lines.en: An explosion far off sounds like a greeting.

lines.zh: 烟从炉口冒出来，我深吸一口。
lines.en: Smoke rises from the forge; I breathe it in.

lines.zh: 金甲导热，烫得我直跳。
lines.en: Gold conducts heat; I hop and curse.

lines.zh: 从库房台阶滚下去，锤子飞了。
lines.en: I tumble down the vault steps; the hammer flies.

lines.zh: 这附近没有水，我却喘不上气。
lines.en: No water nearby, yet I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 自己的炸药，炸了自己的耳朵。
lines.en: My own charge rang my own ears.

lines.zh: 箭插在金甲缝里，拔不出来。
lines.en: An arrow's wedged in the gold seam.

lines.zh: 有股怪力，比锤子还沉。
lines.en: Some strange force weighs more than a hammer.

lines.zh: 饿得举不起锤，先坐会儿。
lines.en: Too hungry to lift the hammer; I sit.

lines.zh: 雷打在铁砧上，我手全麻。
lines.en: Lightning hit the anvil; my hands went numb.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，锤子先掉下去。
lines.en: The floor's gone; the hammer falls first.
